title: SEC-filed U.S. LNG company revenue and operating-cost evidence, FY2024–2025

sources.filing: FY2025 Form 10-K, consolidated statements of operations
accountingNotes: Reported LNG revenue includes derivatives and may include FOB or delivered sales; not destination-specific DOE FOB receipts
Total operating expenses include additional selling/general/admin and other expenses not itemized in this compact comparison
Operating income is total revenue less total operating expenses, not LNG-only margin or net income

sources.filing: FY2025 annual report, results of operations
accountingNotes: Company total revenue, not necessarily solely LNG FOB exports
2025 output increase partly reflects commissioning and ramp-up, not geopolitical supplier displacement
Development costs, depreciation and other expenses affect operating income; financing and tax costs remain below operating line

comparabilityRules: Company SEC-reported consolidated revenue/operating income is observed accounting data, unlike hypothetical DOE volume-times-FOB values
Do not add Venture Global and Cheniere and call sum total U.S. LNG industry revenue; other firms exist
Do not allocate company revenue or operating income to DOE destinations without shipment-level contract and ownership linkage
Operating income is not net profit, free cash flow, tax revenue or national net economic benefit
Revenue and operating costs may include intercompany accounting, derivatives, LNG bought from third parties and non-LNG businesses
Never conflate 2024–2025 annual company accounts with May 2026 DOE monthly destination figures
